cues.en: The gameplay on DaemonSex is somewhere in between a normal first person shooter versus real life. You can only take a couple hits before you're dead, less if you get hit in the head. So this game encourages you to play carefully.
cues.zh: DaemonSex 的玩法和普通第一人称射击游戏与真实生活之间差不多。你只能挨几下就死，爆头的话更少。所以这游戏鼓励你小心谨慎地玩。

cues.en: In general, acting like a serial killer out of a slasher movie where you pick off unsuspecting victims one by one before you slink off into the shadows is going to serve you well in this game.
cues.zh: 总的来说，表现得像砍杀电影里的连环杀手，趁人不备一个一个干掉受害者，然后溜进阴影里，这种玩法在游戏里会很吃香。

cues.en: It even lets you move the body so as not to alert everyone else too quickly.
cues.zh: 它甚至能让你移动尸体，以免太快惊动其他人。

cues.en: My kind of game.
cues.zh: 正合我意。

cues.en: Now you can just sneak past people but that becomes an increasing pain in the ass later.
cues.zh: 你也可以直接偷偷溜过去，但越到后面这越让人头疼。

cues.en: Alternately, you can try for non lethal takedowns but that's not always an option and, frankly, it's harder.
cues.zh: 或者，你可以尝试非致命击倒，但这并不总是可行，而且说实话，更难。

cues.en: If you shoot someone with a tranquilizer dart, they kind of behave like they would in real life which is to say they run around screaming for a good chunk of time alerting everyone in a radius around them, maybe setting off an alarm until they finally collapse.
cues.zh: 如果你用麻醉镖射中某人，他们的反应跟现实中差不多，也就是会尖叫着四处乱跑好一阵子，惊动周围一圈人，可能还会触发警报，直到最后倒下。

cues.en: Also, look at these cyborg guys. They self detonate as soon as you take them down. There is no non lethal takedown of these guys.
cues.zh: 还有，看看这些半机械人。你一放倒他们，他们就自爆。这些人没法非致命击倒。

cues.en: I've heard it's technically possible to beat this game without killing anyone but it involves game exploits that make some areas much more difficult.
cues.zh: 我听说理论上可以不杀任何人通关，但这需要用游戏漏洞，会让某些区域难得多。

cues.en: While your brother is always whining about how you shouldn't kill criminals with guns who are shooting at you, the gameplay suggests otherwise.
cues.zh: 你弟弟总是抱怨你不该开枪打死那些正朝你射击的罪犯，但游戏玩法却给出了相反的答案。

cues.en: So if you just imagine yourself as Jason from Friday the thirteenth except with a badge and gun, then that's the sort of mentality this game is optimized for. Even then, this game isn't all cookies and ice cream regarding the combat.
cues.zh: 所以，你只要把自己想象成《十三号星期五》里的杰森，只不过多了警徽和枪，这就是这款游戏所针对的心态。即便如此，这游戏的战斗也并非全是甜蜜美好。

cues.en: You start off barely being able to hit a target 10 feet in front of you, then there's this small delay between each shot so you never have true semi automatic control. But I actually love how the aiming is handled in this game because this is also an RPG
cues.zh: 一开始你连眼前 10 英尺的目标都 barely 打得中，而且每枪之间还有一小段延迟，所以你永远没有真正的半自动控制。但我其实很喜欢这游戏的瞄准处理方式，因为这也是一款 RPG

cues.en: so you can level up your skills to get better. Because, let's face it, whether you've never picked up a gun before or you're a seasoned veteran,
cues.zh: 所以你可以升级技能来变得更强。因为说实话，不管你以前从没碰过枪，还是身经百战的老手，

cues.en: But aiming,

cues.en: I wish every RPG that had guns handled it this way.
cues.zh: 我希望所有带枪的 RPG 都能这样处理。

cues.en: Progress is a little slow in this game but it's slow in the best possible way because there are people to talk to, new areas to explore,
cues.zh: 这款游戏的进度有点慢，但慢得恰到好处，因为有很多人可以交谈，有新的区域可以探索，

cues.en: conversations of enemies to overhear before you murder them, and so on. All this combined with the hazardous combat makes it feel like an accomplishment when you move forward in this game and just adds a sense of significance to everything.
cues.zh: 可以偷听敌人的对话，然后再把他们干掉，等等。所有这些再加上危险的战斗，让游戏中的每一次推进都像是一种成就，也给一切增添了分量感。

cues.en: Besides being able to talk to everyone you see, you can also read emails,

cues.en: The game is chock full of content. It almost rivals an MMO.

cues.en: So a level that might take you five minutes to get through in another shooter could take you forty five minutes to an hour to get through in Deus Ex because there's so much there.

cues.en: Besides a bar, clinic, hotel, subway,
cues.zh: 除了酒吧、诊所、酒店、地铁，

cues.en: there's also a wealth of side alleys, warehouses,

cues.zh: 隐藏的地下通道，

cues.en: and all along the way, as many homeless people as there are pigeons.

cues.en: And these are just the ones out on the street. There are so many homeless people that later you discover what's practically an underground society of them in decommissioned subway tunnels. Welcome to New York 2052.

cues.en: Pr From here, the plot takes some turns and you go on a globetrotting adventure
cues.zh: 从这里开始，剧情会有所转折，你将开启一场环球冒险，

cues.en: following up leads and,
cues.zh: 顺着线索追查，

cues.en: I forget why you're going everywhere you do. See, this game is so large that by the time you get to a main plot point, you've seen so much of the world around you. If you're not careful, you can lose track of why you were doing what you're here for in the first place.
cues.zh: 我都有点忘了一直奔波是为了什么。你看，这游戏体量太大了，等你推进到主线剧情时，你已经看过太多周遭的世界了。稍不留神，你就会忘了你来这儿到底是为了干什么。

cues.en: The presentation can leave you spinning.
cues.zh: 这种叙事表现可能会让你晕头转向。

cues.en: Like, I'm supposed to do favors for this guy because he wants to help out the local gangs by giving them better sword designs.
cues.zh: 比如，我得帮这家伙的忙，因为他想给当地帮派设计更好的剑来帮他们一把。

cues.en: Now, I do owe him because he saved my life, because I betrayed my organization because my brother got info from some guy saying he found evidence that my bosses took bribe money and maybe were involved with some shadier stuff? I want to emphasize that at no point prior to my betrayal do we have proof of this. It's literally just an email from my brother saying he has proof but we never actually see it. It's all hearsay.
cues.zh: 不过我确实欠他人情，因为他救过我的命，而我背叛了自己的组织，因为我哥从某人那里得到了情报，说他找到了证据证明我的上司受贿，甚至可能牵涉到更阴暗的事情？我想强调的是，在我背叛之前，我们根本没有证据。这纯粹只是我哥发来的一封邮件，说他有证据，但我们从来没真正见过。全都是道听途说。

cues.en: It seems like it would make more sense to just report that to other authorities
cues.zh: 把这些只报告给其他当局似乎更合理

cues.en: or, hell, just resign from your job.
cues.zh: 或者，干脆辞职算了。

cues.en: The plot here would be like if your brother was involved in WikiLeaks and he said said he KNEW another guy in WikiLeaks that said he KNEW the director of Homeland Security had taken Briemont.
cues.zh: 这里的情节就好比，你兄弟参与了维基解密，他说他认识维基解密里另一个人，那人说他知道国土安全部部长收了Briemont。

cues.en: So your conclusion would be to send classified information to militia groups with no PROOF of any of this and go rogue.
cues.zh: 所以你的结论就是，在毫无证据的情况下把机密信息发给民兵组织，然后叛变。

cues.en: Now even if WikiLeaks is right,
cues.zh: 就算维基解密是对的，

cues.en: that still doesn't seem like the correct course of action and more importantly, you see how I got off the topic as to why we're helping some local Chinese gangs?
cues.zh: 那似乎也不是正确的做法，更重要的是，你看出我是怎么跑题到为什么我们在帮当地中国帮派了吗？

cues.en: That's Deus Ex.
cues.zh: 这就是《杀出重围》。

cues.en: But this guy did save my life so I owe him but even then, us stealing some sword design seems really aimless compared to everything else that's happened up until this point. Besides just doing some locals favor, I don't even know what I'm doing anymore.
cues.zh: 但这家伙确实救了我的命，所以我欠他人情，可即便如此，比起之前发生的种种，我们偷个剑的设计图显得毫无目的。除了帮当地人一个忙，我都不知道自己还在干什么了。

cues.en: I'm practically wandering aimlessly.
cues.zh: 我简直就是在漫无目的地游荡。

cues.en: But the world is so fleshed out and the gameplay is just fun so you just go with it. Well, it just so happens that the people who manufacture these swords
cues.zh: 但世界构建得如此丰满，玩法又好玩，所以你就顺着玩下去了。结果碰巧的是，制造这些剑的人

cues.en: ALSO manufacture that virus that was mentioned earlier that's devastating the globe.
cues.zh: 也制造了之前提到的那个正在肆虐全球的病毒。

cues.en: So it all comes together now except there wasn't really a good reason for us to connect the dots to begin with.
cues.zh: 所以现在一切都串起来了，只不过一开始我们根本没有充分的理由把这些线索连起来。

cues.en: Deus Ex.
cues.zh: 《杀出重围》。

cues.zh: Majestic。

cues.zh: 一点也不Majestic。

cues.zh: 后来，游戏开始不断向你抛出一个个阴谋论，比如光明会、

cues.en: the Templars,
cues.zh: 圣殿骑士团、

lab made mutants, Men in Black...

cues.zh: 懂吧？

cues.zh: 统治世界，

cues.en: It's a bit of a mess but the game is so much fun the whole way plus there's a little more going on here that I'm going to come back to. So, in Deus Ex fashion, let me give you a chance to forget what I just said and let's talk about the music. The music in this game ranges from okay......
cues.zh: 整体有点乱，但游戏全程都特别好玩，而且这里面还有更多门道，我之后会再回来说。所以，按照《杀出重围》的风格，让我给你一个忘掉我刚才所说内容的机会，我们来聊聊音乐。这款游戏的音乐水平从还行……

cues.en: To simply amazing.
cues.zh: 到简直惊艳。

cues.en: This game had four different composers but the majority of it was done by Alexander Brandon,
cues.zh: 这款游戏有四位不同的作曲家，但大部分音乐由Alexander Brandon完成，

cues.en: though Michel
cues.zh: 不过Michel

cues.en: Van den Beau had some really excellent tracks also.
cues.zh: Van den Beau也贡献了一些非常出色的曲目。

cues.en: There's so much good music in this game, people who have played it are going to have different answers for which tracks are their favorites.
cues.zh: 这款游戏里的好音乐太多了，玩过的人对于自己最喜欢的曲目会有不同答案。

cues.en: Now, this was one of the last mainstream games to use mod tracker music which is like MIDI music except it's a lot better because the composer gets to choose his own instrument sounds.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这是最后一批使用mod tracker音乐的主流游戏之一，它有点像MIDI音乐，但要好得多，因为作曲家可以自己选择乐器音色。

cues.en: It does mean that some tracks could sound a little clunky, though.
cues.zh: 不过，这也意味着有些曲目听起来可能有点笨重。

cues.en: Clunky is really a good way to describe this game, actually.
cues.zh: 其实，“笨重”这个词很适合用来形容这款游戏。

cues.en: Even at later levels, the combat is never what I would call smooth or fluid.
cues.zh: 即使到了后面的关卡，战斗也从来谈不上流畅顺滑。

cues.en: Everything's a little rough around the edges. Why do I need a timer when I read emails?
cues.zh: 一切都有点粗糙。为什么我读邮件的时候还需要计时器？

cues.en: Why do I jump like a senior citizen?
cues.zh: 为什么我跳起来像个老头？

cues.en: Why is a flashlight a superpower that requires specialized fuel cells?
cues.zh: 为什么手电筒成了一种超能力，还得用专用燃料电池？

cues.en: And pretty much any time you have a game as huge as this is, you're going to have bugs or shortcomings and Deus Ex is no exception. There are loads of small glitches.
cues.zh: 像这么大的游戏，几乎总会有bug或不足之处，《杀出重围》也不例外。小故障一大堆。

cues.en: Like, look at this. The troops have me trapped in here.
cues.zh: 你看，部队把我困在这儿了。

cues.en: I can't get past them. They don't flinch from gunfire either. I literally cannot
cues.zh: 我过不去。他们挨了枪子也不带躲的。我 literally 没法

cues.en: escape without attacking them. Yeah, that's bound to make me popular with The Coalition.
cues.zh: 不攻击他们就逃出去。是啊，这肯定会让我在联盟那儿很受欢迎。

cues.en: This is also a game where if you're trying to break it, you absolutely
cues.zh: 这游戏也是那种你要是想钻空子，绝对

cues.en: can. The first time I played, I was trying to gain entrance to this compound but they were giving me a long runaround for letting me in even though I only had twelve hours to live.
cues.zh: 能钻。我第一次玩的时候，想混进这个院子，但他们一直给我绕圈子不让我进，尽管我只剩十二小时可活了。

cues.en: Then they sent me to this lady that they don't even like and she wants me to break into a police station.
cues.zh: 然后他们把我打发到一个他们自己都不喜欢的女人那儿，她还让我闯警察局。

cues.en: Oh yeah, that's gonna go well. So I decided, hey, how about I use my cybernetic abilities to just sneak into the compound?
cues.zh: 哦对，这肯定顺利得很。所以我决定，嘿，不如我用我的义体能力直接潜进院子？

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 结果

cues.en: that didn't go so well. My,
cues.zh: 不太顺利。我的

cues.en: allies and I weren't becoming the best of friends.
cues.zh: 盟友和我没成什么好朋友。

cues.en: Plus, besides glitches, most of the animations are very basic.
cues.zh: 另外，除了故障，大部分动画都非常简陋。

cues.en: Half the people in Hong Kong don't exactly look Chinese You missed them. They left over an hour ago. And their accents could use some work. Illegal products, of course, but you find everything in the canals,
cues.zh: 香港有一半人看着都不太像中国人。你错过他们了。他们一个多小时前就走了。而且他们的口音也该练练。当然是非法产品，但在运河里什么都能找到，

cues.en: things that have been lost, things people wants to get.]
cues.zh: 丢失的东西，人们想要的东西。]

cues.en: This is a game you have to use your imagination on, like how a group of underground terrorists are all wearing conveniently matching uniforms,
cues.zh: 这是个得靠想象力的游戏，比如一群地下恐怖分子都穿着恰好配套的制服，

cues.en: or how every major city you visit only has a dozen or two people on the street, or how you can drink ten forty ounces in five seconds and not die.
cues.zh: 或者你去的每座大城市街上只有一二十个人，或者你能五秒喝下十个40盎司还不死。

cues.en: You just can't take everything at face value with a game like this. Another thing you have to overlook is that even though you're the hero,
cues.zh: 这种游戏你不能什么都当真。还有一点你得忽略：就算你是英雄，

cues.en: the game still encourages you to play like a criminal anyway.
cues.zh: 游戏还是鼓励你像罪犯一样玩。

cues.en: If you're not breaking and entering, picking locks and stealing everything you can find, you're going to have a hard time. It doesn't matter if you're stealing from rich or poor, your own colleagues or complete strangers,
cues.zh: 如果你不闯门入室、撬锁、把能偷的都偷光，就会很难混。不管你偷的是富人穷人、自己同事还是完全陌生的人，

cues.en: you need their stuff.
cues.zh: 你就是需要他们的东西。

cues.en: At least with hacking into people's email, you're trying to gather intelligence. Intelligence. By hacking ATM machines so you can steal $100
cues.zh: 至少黑进别人邮箱时，你是在收集情报。情报。而黑进ATM机就为偷100美元，

cues.en: is a little less classy.
cues.zh: 就有点不那么体面了。

cues.en: It would be like if James Bond sabotaged a vending machine so he could steal $20 from it. This isn't a good game to overthink,
cues.zh: 这就像James Bond破坏自动售货机，就为了从里面偷20美元。这游戏不适合想太多，

cues.en: or at least not the gameplay.
cues.zh: 至少别对玩法想太多。

cues.en: But for all its quirks, it does so many little things to make it seem real.
cues.zh: 但尽管有这么多怪癖，它做了很多小细节让它显得真实。

cues.en: Even simple things like breathing animations add a lot.
cues.zh: 就连呼吸动画这种简单的东西也加分不少。

cues.en: And it may look simplistic now but this lip syncing goes a long way towards helping to immerse me. Or hey, if you shoot a foot soldier a couple times, guess what they do?
cues.zh: 现在看可能很简单，但这种口型同步对让我沉浸进去帮助很大。或者嘿，你要是朝一个小兵开几枪，猜猜他们会怎样？

cues.en: They run away.
cues.zh: 它们会逃跑。

cues.en: They don't come back either. That's because they are scared for their life.
cues.zh: 它们也不会回来。因为它们怕丢了命。

cues.en: How many first person shooters do that?
cues.zh: 有多少第一人称射击游戏会这么做？

cues.en: Things like this add up. Now, I should probably mention that because this was made on the Unreal Engine which is highly moddable,
cues.zh: 这种事会积少成多。现在我得提一下，因为这是用虚幻引擎做的，而虚幻引擎的模组化程度很高，

cues.en: there have been some serious mods made for this game. Total Conversions, actually.
cues.zh: 所以这款游戏有不少严肃的 mod。其实是完全转换（Total Conversion）。

cues.en: Haven't had a chance to play all these though the Nameless mod I did give a shot.
cues.zh: 我还没机会把这些都玩一遍，不过 Nameless mod 我确实试了试。

cues.en: I didn't get very far though because if you're expecting something like Deus Ex, you should keep looking. It's more like a runaway project from an online community that's only intended audience is itself.
cues.zh: 但我没玩多远，因为如果你期待的是 Deus Ex 那样的东西，那还是别找了。它更像一个网络社区里跑偏的项目，唯一的目标受众就是它自己。

cues.en: It has a lot of humor that breaks the fourth wall,
cues.zh: 它有很多打破第四面墙的幽默，

cues.en: isn't that funny, and you're probably not going to get it unless you were part of this community. I think this mod could possibly be the largest inside joke ever made.
cues.zh: 有那么好笑吗？除非你曾是那个社区的一员，否则你大概懂不了。我觉得这个 mod 可能是有史以来最大的圈内梗。

cues.en: At fourteen hours of gameplay, it's an oddity that you wouldn't think exists
cues.zh: 14 小时的游戏流程，它是个你本以为不会存在的怪东西，

cues.en: but here it is.
cues.zh: 但它还真存在。

cues.en: Additionally, Deus Ex Revision is the most recent and is intended to be an overhaul of the original game to add some more features, particularly visuals.
cues.zh: 另外，Deus Ex Revision 是最新的，打算对原版游戏做一次大修，加入更多功能，尤其是画面。

cues.en: This one reminds me a little bit of George Lucas going back and altering the original Star Wars in order to enhance it.
cues.zh: 这个让我有点想起 George Lucas 回去修改原版 Star Wars 来增强它。

cues.en: Although that's a little unfair because I think this mod respects the source material more than Lucas did. Some things are better, others are questionable.
cues.zh: 不过这么说有点不公平，因为我觉得这个 mod 比 Lucas 更尊重原作。有些地方更好了，有些则值得商榷。

cues.en: Like, you look at your boss' office here, it's looking a lot more posh now but who would position a luxury office so everyone has to approach you from the side?
cues.zh: 你看这里老板的办公室，现在看起来气派多了，但谁会这样摆一间豪华办公室，让所有人都得从侧面接近你？

cues.en: The original has a wall separating things. You're always facing him. That's bad feng shui.
cues.zh: 原版里有一堵墙把空间隔开。你总是正对着他。这风水不好。

cues.en: Also, look at the beginning here. Let's stop for a minute and imagine what happened just before this conversation took place.
cues.zh: 还有，看这里的开头。我们停一下，想象这段对话发生前刚刚出了什么事。

cues.en: Did they decide, Hey, let's both stand inside the middle of this information terminal because it will feel cozier?
cues.zh: 他们是决定“嘿，咱俩都站到这个信息终端正中间吧，这样感觉更温馨”吗？

cues.en: This mod really accentuates how much thought was actually put into the original's level design.
cues.zh: 这个 mod 确实更凸显出原版关卡设计投入了多少思考。

cues.en: A lot of areas start feeling too cluttered and you lose track visually of where you should be focusing your attention.
cues.zh: 很多区域开始显得太杂乱，你在视觉上会失去该关注哪里的线索。

cues.en: So, not bad but I would still recommend anyone new to just play the original
cues.zh: 所以，不算差，但我还是建议任何新玩家直接玩原版

cues.en: And while I'm talking about the Unreal Engine, I have to point out that Deus Ex used a trick the original Unreal did and that if you get close to a wall, you can see a secondary texture emerge.
cues.zh: 说到 Unreal Engine，我必须指出，Deus Ex 沿用了原版 Unreal 的一个技巧：当你靠近墙时，能看到第二层纹理浮现出来。

cues.en: So on wood, you can see the grain, on paintings, you can see the canvas texture, and so on. Now unlike Unreal, which did this on almost everything,
cues.zh: 所以木头上能看到木纹，画上能看到画布纹理，等等。而 Unreal 几乎对所有东西都这么做，

cues.en: Deus Ex only uses this on some textures but this was so far ahead of anything else for years.
cues.zh: Deus Ex 只在部分纹理上用了这个，但多年来这远远领先于其他一切。

cues.en: It meant when you got close to something, it wasn't a complete blurfest.
cues.zh: 这意味着当你靠近某个东西时，它不会完全糊成一片。

cues.en: Usually.
cues.zh: 通常如此。

cues.en: Okay, now I'm skipping huge aspects of this game, probably more than any other game I've covered, but I want to keep moving because I want to circle back around something. While it's far from perfect and has a lot of shortcomings,
cues.zh: 好，现在我跳过了这款游戏的大量内容，可能比我讲过的任何游戏都多，但我想继续推进，因为我想绕回去讲某件事。虽然它远非完美，也有很多缺点，

cues.en: Deus Ex is a great game by pretty much any metric.
cues.zh: 但无论用什么标准衡量，Deus Ex 都是一款伟大的游戏。

cues.en: Yeah, all time favorite of mine. No surprises there. The thing is, I would argue from a certain light,
cues.zh: 对，我一直以来的最爱。不意外。问题是，从某种角度看，我会说，

cues.en: this is the most significant game ever made
cues.zh: 这是有史以来最重要的游戏

cues.en: and it's for none of the reasons I've discussed so far. I need to talk more about the story because this is where I think most of the game industry doesn't realize what it has with this game or else can't talk about it fully because they have to stay more objective.
cues.zh: 而且原因完全不是我目前讨论过的那些。我需要多谈谈剧情，因为我认为大多数游戏行业人士没意识到这款游戏拥有什么，或者因为得保持更客观，没法把它讲透。

cues.en: Well, not me. I can say whatever the hell I want. So, here we go.
cues.zh: 但我不是。我想说什么就说什么。那开始吧。

cues.en: See, the story to Deus Ex exists on two or three levels.
cues.zh: 你看，Deus Ex 的剧情有两三个层次。

cues.en: The first level is what I would call fun video game story.
cues.zh: 第一层是我所谓的“好玩的电子游戏剧情”。

cues.en: You're stopping terrorists, fighting against a malevolent organization,
cues.zh: 你在阻止恐怖分子，对抗一个邪恶组织，

cues.en: saving the world from a virus,
cues.zh: 从病毒手中拯救世界，

cues.en: uncovering the Illuminati,
cues.zh: 揭穿光明会，

cues.en: blowing up mechs. This is nothing we haven't seen in other games already. It's not too deep. You're not meant to take this seriously.
cues.zh: 炸毁机甲。这些在其他游戏里早就见过了。它不算太深。你本来也不该把它当真。
